Question: A box contains \(28\) red balls, \(20\) green balls, \(19\) yellow balls, \(13\) blue balls, \(11\) white balls, and \(9\) black balls. What is the minimum number of balls that must be drawn from the box without replacement to guarantee that at least \(15\) balls of a single color will be drawn?
